convert_sam_checkpoint: convert a SAM or SlimSAM checkpoint from the original repository to Hugging Face Transformers format
get_config: get a SamConfig with the correct vision config for sam_vit_b, sam_vit_l, sam_vit_h, slimsam-50, or slimsam-77 model names
replace_keys: replace original SAM checkpoint state dict keys to match Hugging Face model naming conventions
run_sam_checkpoint_conversion_cli: run the SAM-to-HF conversion CLI with model name, checkpoint path, output folder, and optional hub push
review_convert_sam_checkpoint: review the convert_sam_checkpoint function that loads, remaps keys, validates inference, and saves or pushes the converted model
